parts.text: How many days of paid outpatient sick leave and hospitalization leave do full-time employees get in Singapore according to our handbook?

According to the Altostrat Singapore Employee Policy Handbook & Conduct Guidelines (Section 1.1 & Section 19 / Section 25: Outpatient Sick Time & Hospitalization Leave (Singapore)), eligible full-time employees receive up to 14 days of paid outpatient sick leave per calendar year and up to 60 days of paid hospitalization leave per calendar year (consisting of an additional 46 work days, inclusive of the 14 outpatient days). A Medical Certificate (MC) from a registered medical practitioner is required if sick leave exceeds 2 consecutive work days.

Full-time eligible employees in Singapore receive up to 14 days of paid outpatient sick leave and up to 60 days of paid hospitalization leave per calendar year (inclusive of the 14 outpatient days), per Section 25 of the Altostrat Singapore Employee Policy Handbook (gs://sales-demo-492804-hr-policies-source/handbook.pdf).

eval_cases.context: Section 25: SICK TIME & HOSPITALIZATION LEAVE (SINGAPORE). Full-time employees who have completed at least 6 months of service are entitled to 14 days of paid outpatient sick leave per calendar year and up to 60 days of paid hospitalization leave per calendar year (inclusive of the 14 days of outpatient sick leave).
